correctness.rationale: The exact EF21 scalar update closes on four exchangeable second moments. The induced positive covariance operator has unit-eigenvalue determinant \(s[6n-(n+8)s]/(16n)\). Stability exists for sufficiently small positive steps by the source PL theorem, the spectral radius is unbounded for large steps, and positivity forces any unit-modulus stability crossing through \(+1\); hence \(6n/(n+8)\) is the unique positive mean-square boundary. The deterministic many-worker limit independently has exact Jury ceiling \(6\).

value.rationale: The exact frontier turns EF21's qualitative large-step robustness into a sharp distributed benchmark. Independent worker averaging expands the admissible normalized step from \(2/3\) at one worker to \(6\) in the mean-field limit, crossing the ordinary gradient-descent ceiling at four workers. This provides a concrete stability mechanism and a reproducible test for compressed distributed implementations.
